title: Rust CLI delegates now-generate-internal to PATH kanbus (clap unknown subcommand)
description:
## Problem

When `kbs` is the Rust binary (default after install), standup and right-now summary generation fails because `delegate_right_now_summary_to_python` shells out to `kanbus now-generate-internal`, which is a Python-only hidden subcommand.

## Symptom

```
error: unrecognized subcommand 'now-generate-internal'
```

Rust `kbs standup` (and related right-now flows) invoke `Command::new("kanbus").args(["now-generate-internal", ...])`. When PATH resolves `kanbus` to the Rust binary, clap rejects the subcommand.

## Context

- Parent initiative: kbs-60f3d0 (on-demand daily standup report)
- Python implementation: `python/src/kanbus/cli.py` defines `now-generate-internal` (hidden)
- Rust caller: `rust/src/right_now.rs` `delegate_right_now_summary_to_python`

## Expected fix direction

Rust should either implement `now-generate-internal` natively or invoke the Python CLI explicitly (not PATH `kanbus`) so Rust-as-default installs work.
